CameraVideo

class CameraVideo(camera_index, use_low_resolution=False)[source]

Bases: QThread

Capture camera frames in a thread and emit them as images.

Parameters:
camera_indexint

OpenCV index of the camera.

use_low_resolutionbool, optional

If True, keep the camera’s default resolution; otherwise set the width and height configured in CalibrationService. Default is False.

Attributes:
frame_readySignal(QImage)

Emitted for each captured frame, as an RGB888 image that a QLabel can display directly.

camera_indexint

OpenCV index of the camera.

use_low_resolutionbool

Whether the configured resolution is skipped.

runningbool

Loop flag; set to True by run and to False by stop.

capcv2.VideoCapture | None

The open capture device, or None before run.

serviceCalibrationService

Source of the OpenCV settings.

Notes

The camera is opened with the backend from get_opencv_capture_backend(); the Windows and non-Windows branches are currently identical.

The emitted QImage wraps the frame buffer without copying it.

run emits self.error_signal when the camera cannot be opened, but this class defines no such signal, so that case raises AttributeError. TODO(doc): add error_signal = Signal(str) as in CameraVideoThread?

The error message uses self.tr() (runtime Qt translation).

Methods

run

Capture frames until stopped or the camera fails.

stop

Stop the capture loop and wait for the thread to finish.
run()[source]

Capture frames until stopped or the camera fails.

Runs in the thread when start() is called. Each frame is converted from BGR (OpenCV) to RGB and emitted through frame_ready. The loop ends when stop is called or a frame cannot be read (e.g. camera disconnected); the camera is then released.

stop()[source]

Stop the capture loop and wait for the thread to finish.
